recipe: Main free-skate -> native pause -> focus and actual mouse click Controls. Resize native viewport and apply 1.4x user setting. Actual wheel events scroll to bottom; focus reaches Back. No profile writes or synthetic HUD snapshot.

records.help_text:
Hold Ollie to crouch; release to pop. Direction + Flip / Grab selects a trick. Hold grabs.
Tap Grind to lock a rail; tap again to drop. Hold Grind at quarter-pipe coping for a lip trick.
Manual + Up selects Nose Manual. Up–neutral–Down / Down–neutral–Up also starts a manual / nose manual.
Air left/right spins the skater; shoulders spin too. Quarter-pipe and half-pipe: Clyde quay.
records.label: controls-1280-top
